## LCA Notes
This is a cradle to gate with options Environmental Product Declaration. The following life cycle phases were considered: Benefits and Construction Loads Beyond Product Stage Use Stage End of Life Stage* Process Stage the System Boundaries Deconstruction gate to the site Transport from Refurbishment Manufacturing Construction/ Replacement Raw material Maintenance Operational Operational energy use /demolition processing installation Recovery- Recycling water use Transport Transport Disposal potential process Reuse- Repair supply Waste Use A1 A2 A3 A4 A5 B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B6 B7 C1 C2 C3 C4 D X X X X X MND MND MND MND MND MND MND MND X X X X Description of the System Boundary Stages Corresponding to the PCR (X = Included; MND = Module Not Declared) *This includes provision of all materials, products and energy, packaging processing and its transport, as well as waste processing up to the end-of waste state or disposal of final residues.

## Source Data Notes
used are complete and representative of North America in terms of the geographic and technological coverage and are a recent vintage (i.e. less than ten years old). The data used for primary data are based on direct information sources of the manufacturer. Secondary data sets were used for raw materials extraction and processing, end of life, transportation, and energy production flows. Wherever secondary data is used, the study adopts critically reviewed data for consistency, precision, and reproducibility to limit uncertainty. Period Under Review The period under review is the full calendar year of 2016. Where data was incomplete, annual 2015 data was used and was deemed representative for the product. Allocation Allocation was determined on a per unit basis. Comparability A comparison or an evaluation of EPD data is only possible if all data sets to be compared were created according to EN 15804 and the building context, respectively the product-specific characteristics of performance, are taken into account. Environmental delarations from different programs may not be comparable. Full conformance with the PCR for North American Builders Hardware products allows EPD comparability only when all stages of a Builders Hardware product's life cycle have been considered. However, variations and deviations are possible. name: Pemko Silicone Adhesive Smoke and Fire Gasket
description: Product name: Pemko Silicon Adhesive Smoke and Fire Gasket Pemko produces a range of gasket products in a variety of shapes and configurations. Nine gasket configurations have been analyzed, and this EPD presents the worst case scenario for these nine variations. Specifically, this EPD is representative of the following Pemko gasket products: - S44 - S77 - S88 - S442 - S771 - S772 - S773 - S776 - S771x6 Pemko Silicon Adhesive Smoke and Fire Gaskets are adhesive-backed, silicone gasketing products installed on the perimeter of a door opening or at the meeting edges of a pair of doors to slow/prohibit the passage of smoke, fire, weather, sound, and dirt. They are rigorously tested and offered in many colors (finishes) guaranteed to blend unobrusively into any structure. Addtional features include: - Effective temperature range of -58 to +450 degrees Farenheit - Manufactured using high quality cross linked silicon polymer - Includes high quality acrylic adhesive for secure application - Exceeds air infiltration ratings by a factor of 7 or better - Is 93% efficient for sound control when applied in a double row - Self-extinguishing, non-toxic - Unaffected by sunlight, ozone, and ultraviolet rays - Impervious to fungus and mildew - Product is packaged with an alcohol towelette for frame cleaning and a mylar label. Otherwise, no other accessory materials are required for installation or use. Application Pemko Silicone Adhesive Gaskets are ideal for a wide range of applications, including but not limited to high traffic areas, hotels, offices, public buildings, hospitals, institutions, educational facilities, and retail spaces. Technical Data For the declared product, the following technical data in the delivery status must be provided with reference to the test standard: Technical Data Length 17' (Multiple Lengths Available) Width Up to 1" Height Up to 0.375"
